findings.observation: Checkpoint draining advances the coordinator's Ready state without concurrently consuming or timestamping the control interaction FIFO, so queued interactions can cross the readiness cutover.
findings.impact: If a checkpoint overlaps the server readiness transition, an interaction emitted before Ready can remain queued throughout the checkpoint and then be forwarded as though it were post-Ready, violating the sealed drop-before-Ready boundary.
findings.recommendation: Make the Ready cutover and interaction classification explicit across checkpoints: drain and drop every interaction known to precede Ready while checkpoint correlation remains live, then begin forwarding only interactions admitted after the cutover, preserving FIFO. Add a deterministic before/after Ready regression.

coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:2177-2183 consumes control interactions only after checkpoint_with_realtime returns.
coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/process.rs:1758-1769 admits interactions regardless of lifecycle permit or coordinator readiness.

findings.observation: The mint wait latches CheckpointReady but both shutdown exits discard that latch instead of completing the checkpoint before child shutdown.
findings.impact: A shutdown race can discard a known finite checkpoint opportunity and force child termination, risking recent gameplay progress.
findings.recommendation: On mint-wait shutdown, reconcile any latched CheckpointReady with the existing finite checkpoint path before stopping children, while treating the canceled mint as terminal and never reminting. Add first- and second-mint race tests.
evidence: coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:130-133 records CheckpointReady while mint is pending.
coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/session.rs:2051-2059 and 2070-2078 shut down without reconciling pending_checkpoint.
coop/crates/coop-launcher/src/process.rs:2738-2741 skips graceful authenticated shutdown when checkpoint_drained is false.

findings.observation: The candidate's deterministic tests never exercise a successful mint and live realtime coordinator lifecycle.
findings.impact: Ready gating, freshest-state handoff, lifecycle backpressure, checkpoint coexistence, child settlement ordering, and successful task termination can regress while all added tests remain green.
findings.recommendation: Add a successful one-use grant and deterministic loopback WebSocket plus authenticated control fixture covering Ready, state, pre/post-Ready interaction, lifecycle mapping, checkpoint overlap, terminal behavior, and joined teardown.
